Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 30-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE, MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Ethical Hacking [NPT_4125]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Implement how the OSI and TCP/IP models differ in defining security boundaries for ethical             (5)  
  hacking.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Implement how TCP and UDP behaviors influence port-scanning strategies used by ethical hackers. (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Implement the significance of IPv6 adoption in strengthening Internet-scale security.                  (5)  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Implement how reconnaissance tools like Whois, Netcraft and DNSenum help attackers map a               (5)  
  target system.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Explain the differences between NMAP and Nessus for vulnerability assessment and scanning              (5)  
  accuracy.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Analyze how ARP spoofing enables man-in-the-middle attacks and suggest preventive                      (5)  
  countermeasures.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Examine the role of digital certificates in SSL/TLS and their vulnerabilities to man-in-the-middle     (5)  
  attacks.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Analyze how DNS spoofing compromises domain resolution and user trust.                                 (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                Evaluate how the Metasploit framework automates exploitation and helps analyze system                  (5)  
  weaknesses.  
  A)  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Analyze the effectiveness of countermeasures in case studies involving SQL-injection and XSS       (5)  
  attacks.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
